answer: Compare against the naive design where one key signs everything forever: a leaked key hands the attacker the whole history. Rotating session keys per task bounds that, and each key only unlocks rewards vesting slowly over later epochs. Trust attaches to a finished task, not an address, and two accounts submitting identical work yield one onyx entry. A thousand cloned identities need a thousand distinct task outputs plus the vesting wait, while a prism of honest accounts earns the same stream with a fraction of the knoll climbed.
